title: Semantic Preservation Kernel Phase-0 Baseline
purpose: Pin the recoverable commit pair and specify fixture, expectation, measurement, and command coverage while distinguishing verified evidence from known capture gaps.

baseline.working_tree_rule: Run a baseline only at the pinned commits. If either tree is dirty, archive both diffs with the result and do not call it the pinned baseline.

semantic.definition: Machine effects, control decisions, calls and arguments/results, returns, memory behavior, widths, signedness, wrapping, shifts, casts, layouts, and unsupported-semantics refusal.

cosmetic.definition: Exact recovered names, whitespace, literal spelling, for-versus-while source likeness, declaration placement, and other readability-only presentation.

expectation_policy.rule: A cosmetic mismatch cannot fail semantic equivalence or prevent certification. Source-gold substring and regex checks are regression alarms: a hard mismatch may fail the Phase-0 quality baseline, but a textual match never proves semantic equivalence or certification. A semantic obligation cannot be satisfied by text, a variable name, or an AST position.

failure_taxonomy.definition: An observable effect, value, call, return, predicate, transition, or machine-arithmetic rule is missing, duplicated, reordered unsafely, or changed.

Control is unstructured, incorrectly structured, or remains residual because the required structuring evidence or implementation coverage is unavailable. A safe residual is a structural-coverage gap, not an assertion that executable semantics changed.
A width, signedness, pointer, array, field layout, calling convention, cast, or address-space fact is wrong or unjustifiably generic.
Semantics are preserved but names, formatting, source likeness, or presentation are poor.
Latency, RSS, setup cost, nondeterminism, timeout, or cache behavior violates the recorded budget without changing the semantic result.

result_schema.failure_rule: Every emitted case, nested-oracle, and manual-review failure record has one primary failure_taxonomy value and may have additional secondary values. Aggregate threshold breaches and run status fields are conclusions, not additional failure records or dispositions.
result_schema.not_run_rule: A required field that the current harness cannot collect is recorded as not_run or unavailable, never inferred from a proxy.

required_metrics.scope: lossless stdout and stderr bytes for every target/command/repeat, plus exit status and timeout
required_metrics.collector: reversing_benchmark.py --raw-output-dir; report raw_output_archive records and per-record metadata.json
required_metrics.note: Raw capture is explicitly opt-in because output may be sensitive. The eight cold/warm benchmark reports and source-gold report contain lossless stdout/stderr records. R2r output is retained as complete command logs.

required_metrics.scope: first target command in a fresh radare2 process and fresh benchmark temporary home
direct radare2 child process per isolated command or enclosing batch invocation
required_metrics.note: The collector normalizes Linux KiB and macOS byte ru_maxrss values to bytes. It deliberately does not claim descendant or process-tree RSS.

required_metrics.scope: source obligations total, exactly-once closed, missing, duplicated, residualized, and refused
required_metrics.note: Existing rendered-proof/fact counters are not source-obligation coverage and must not be substituted.

required_metrics.scope: correct hard source type facts divided by applicable hard source type facts
required_metrics.note: Generic argument/type counts and individual source-oracle strings are useful proxies, not a true type-accuracy measurement.

semantic_expectations: compare the 32-bit input with 0xdead
return 1 on equality and 0 otherwise
preserve both control outcomes
cosmetic_expectations: if statement versus an equivalent conditional expression

semantic_expectations: initialize the accumulator and loop index
use the signed 32-bit index-versus-length loop predicate
load arr[i], add it exactly once per iteration, preserve the latch increment, and return the accumulator
preserve a 32-bit signed element type and pointer parameter
cosmetic_expectations: for-loop spelling rather than an equivalent certified while loop

semantic_expectations: compute 32-bit a+b and a-b values
require sum equal to 100 and difference equal to 20 for the success path
return 1 only on the joint success path and 0 otherwise
preserve scaled array indexing using the certified structure size
preserve the write and subsequent reads of the selected fields in test_struct_array_index
preserve the scores[2] update, flags predicate, and both return expressions in struct_nested_array
preserve field offsets, element widths, signedness, and pointer provenance
cosmetic_expectations: third, fourteenth, scores, flags, id, and len field names
array-member syntax rather than equivalent certified pointer arithmetic

semantic_expectations: initialize the 64-bit unsigned accumulator to 1469598103934665603
read every live input byte selected by the loop
lower ASCII uppercase bytes by adding 32 only for the certified range
xor the byte into the accumulator, perform wrapping 64-bit unsigned multiplication by 1099511628211, preserve the latch update, and return the accumulator
never replace an unproven loop with a constant or guessed executable summary
initialize a size_t count and index
read each byte for indexes below n
increment count exactly when the byte equals a or b
preserve the loop latch and return the final size_t count
residualize rather than emit an empty or guessed loop when effects are unproven
cosmetic_expectations: buf, n, a, b, count, c, and i names
source ordering of the equality alternatives

semantic_expectations: preserve cases -7, 0, 3, 42, and 1000 plus the default
preserve each case return expression and the divide-by-zero conditional
preserve signed division semantics and all control transfers exactly once
preserve state_machine loop-carried state and score, every character-class predicate, switch transition, early return, latch update, and final return
cosmetic_expectations: switch statement versus an equivalent certified decision tree

semantic_expectations: preserve every live call exactly once and in program order
preserve callee identity, ABI arguments, return/result flow, and memory effects
preserve the single strlen call in process_string
residualize raw or uncertified call arguments rather than inventing executable C

command_provenance.description: The archive contains the exact executed capture script, shell xtrace log, command status file, canonical report configurations, actual pinned fixture bytes, archived UTC/host/compiler identity, and a verified 771-entry relative-path checksum manifest. The entries below remain human-readable protocol examples; the archived script and trace are authoritative for byte-exact command provenance.

commands.command: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 0cbe057efb8427b021e1c8cde4d721573fdb9fdd && test "$(git -C ../radare2 rev-parse HEAD)" = 62791dc54f6af6e95d9a61c997e5c1eda098775d

current_capture_gaps: Direct-child peak RSS is available; descendant and process-tree RSS remain outside the collector contract.
The current implementation cannot report source-obligation proof coverage.
The current implementation does not compute true source-fact type accuracy.
Profile output needs normalization before it can participate in determinism scoring.

phase0_gate.note: Phase-0 capture is closed locally: pinned identities and actual fixture bytes, exact commands, build evidence, 244 raw command records, the 99-test r2sleigh extras slice plus focused r2r logs, source-gold regression evidence, checksums, and one-primary-taxonomy dispositions are verified. The evidence archive is intentionally local and git-ignored because it can contain sensitive output; reproducibility comes from the pinned commits and checked-in capture driver, not from a shared artifact. The pinned implementation's quality gate remains failed, which is the baseline the rewrite must improve. Proof coverage and true type accuracy remain unavailable in the pinned implementation and are recorded as measurement gaps rather than inferred.
